---
name: "nf-core/fastq_download_prefetch_fasterqdump_sratools"
description: "Download FASTQ sequencing reads from the NCBI's Sequence Read Archive\
  \ (SRA)."
keywords:
- "SRA"
- "NCBI"
- "sequencing"
- "fastq"
- "prefetch"
- "fasterq-dump"
components:
- "custom/sratoolsncbisettings"
- "sratools/prefetch"
- "sratools/fasterqdump"
input:
- ch_sra_ids:
    type: "string"
    description: "SRA run identifier.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), val(id) ]\n"
- ch_dbgap_key:
    type: "file"
    description: "Path to a JWT cart file used to access protected dbGAP data on SRA\
      \ using the sra-toolkit\n\nStructure: [ path(dbgap_key) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.cart"
output:
- reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "Extracted FASTQ file or files if the sequencing reads are paired-end.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(reads) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.fastq.gz"
authors:
- "@Midnighter"
- "@drpatelh"
maintainers:
- "@Midnighter"
- "@drpatelh"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/custom/sratoolsncbisettings@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/sratools/prefetch@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/sratools/fasterqdump@0.0.0-6d1763b"
